stories.story_fr: Brookfield a atteint son objectif de recyclage de capital de 2 milliards de dollars pour 2024.
stories.story_en: Brookfield successfully reached its $2 billion capital recycling target for 2024.
stories.quote: successfully reaching our $2 billion capital recycling target for the year

stories.short: Backlog growth driven by AI and decarbonisation
stories.story_fr: Le capital backlog a augmenté de 20 % grâce aux opportunités liées à l'IA et à la décarbonisation.
stories.story_en: The capital backlog grew 20% driven by AI and decarbonisation opportunities.
stories.quote: We have seen this translate into a 20% increase in our capital backlog in the last twelve months

stories.story_fr: Le résultat net du deuxième trimestre 2025 passe de 8 M$ à 69 M$, marquant une nette amélioration.
stories.story_en: Q2 2025 net income jumps from $8 million to $69 million, marking a clear turnaround.
stories.quote: Brookfield Infrastructure reported net income of $69 million for the three-month period ended June 30 2025 compared to $8 million in the prior year

stories.short: Hedging losses offset growth in Q3 2024
stories.story_fr: Les pertes de couverture sur les contrats de matières premières ont annulé la croissance du troisième trimestre 2024.
stories.story_en: Mark‑to‑market hedging losses offset growth in Q3 2024.
stories.quote: Strong growth within our businesses was more than offset by mark‑to‑market losses on our corporate hedging activities

stories.story_fr: Plus de 1,5 milliard de dollars ont été investis dans de nouveaux projets de centres de données au cours des 12 derniers mois.
stories.story_en: Over $1.5 billion has been deployed in new data‑center projects over the past 12 months.
stories.quote: commissioning of over $1.5 billion in new capital projects from our backlog over the past 12 months, particularly within our data center platform
